sources: recreation.gov public search API campsite catalog for facility 261696 (catx.py)

values.note: Construction closure: 'Temporary closure Oct. 12 to Nov. 8 (previously scheduled to close Aug. 20 to Sept. 12). Alternative camping may be available at Devil's Elbow, Log Gulch, or White Sandy.'

status.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/holter-lake-campground ('Temporary closure Oct. 12 to Nov. 8 (previously scheduled to close Aug. 20 to Sept. 12). Alternative camping may be available at Devil's Elbow, Log Gulch, or White Sandy. For more information, call 406-258-0279 or check Recreation.gov. Thank you for your patience as important site improvements are completed!'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 52 sites with level gravel pads, 9 of them tent-only; most take up to two RVs or tents. recreation.gov lists 42 RV non-electric sites, maximum vehicle lengths mostly 30-68 ft (one 24 ft, one 28 ft).

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/holter-lake-campground ('Holter Lake Campground is a 52-site campground that has spacious and level gravel parking pads that accommodate RVs, camper trailers, and tents. There are 9 tent-only sites.') + recreation.gov catalog for facility 261696 (42 RV NONELECTRIC overnight sites; max vehicle length 24-68 ft), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/holter-lake-campground ('There are no hook-ups available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261696 (notices: 'No hook-ups are available. Potable water is available throughout the campground to fill containers.', 'There is no power available on-site for campers.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Potable water to fill containers (peak season); garbage dumpsters; fire rings with grill grates in Loop A and the tent area. Concrete boat launch with courtesy dock and first-come day-use and overnight dock slips for campers; beach access.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/holter-lake-campground ('There is potable water provided throughout the campground and day-use areas, as well as garbage dumpsters', 'accessible double vault toilets', boat launch and dock slips) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261696 (amenities 'Vault Toilets', 'Drinking Water (peak season)', 'Beach Access'; notice 'There is no black or grey water dump on site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: BLM Butte Field Office campground with a host. All 52 sites are reservation-only; 'First come first serve sites may be available on a daily basis after 2pm but are not guaranteed.' recreation.gov's rate table also lists first-come seasons in April and October-November around the May 1 - Sept 30 peak season. Stay limit 7 consecutive days and 14 days in 28; up to 2 sites held at once. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/holter-lake-campground ('Of the 52 sites, all are reservation only. First come first serve sites may be available on a daily basis after 2pm but are not guaranteed.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261696 (notices 'ALL SITES RESERVATION ONLY', 'Stay limit is 7 consecutive days and 14 days within a 28-day time period'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 7, maxConcurrentStay 2) and /rates, read 2026-10-22

values.note: $25 per RV, trailer or tent, up to two camping units per site.

fees.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/holter-lake-campground ('Each RV/trailer/tent costs $25 with a max of two of any combination per site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261696/rates (2026 Peak Season and FCFS seasons, RV non-electric $25), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261696 (notice: 'Discounts are only available for those carrying a Senior or Access National Park Pass.'), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM Butte Field Office campground on Holter Lake (Missouri River) near Wolf Creek, every site with a view of the lake and the Sleeping Giant; swimming beach, boat ramp and docks. Part of the Holter Lake/Log Gulch/Departure Point complex. --Claude
summary: BLM page + recreation.gov: confirmed 52 sites (9 tent-only), no hookups, potable water, vault toilets, $25/night, reservable on recreation.gov, Senior/Access discount; recorded a current temporary closure (Oct 12 - Nov 8, 2026, site improvements). Changed fcfs never -> after_cutoff (unreserved sites may go first-come after 2 pm); added max length 68 ft, 7-night limit, no dump. Not stated: campground season (rate seasons only). Note trimmed of restated values.
